profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Stanford University
•M.S. in EE, class of 2013
•B.S. in Physics and Electrical Engineering, 2012 (double major)
(My advanced courses focused on topics in machine learning)

Currently coding at LiftIgniter.

Interests:
-Doing machine learning and information retrieval on large, distributed datasets.
-Creating big data infrastructure for analytics.
-Leveraging the following frameworks: Spark, Cassandra, ElasticSearch, Akka, Aerospike
-Writing code in: Scala, Python, (generally I like learning new languages too)
-Finding new and innovative ways to test code for complex systems (leveraging both unit testing and property based testing)
-Working with others in both a collaborative and a mentorship role to create amazing tools and products

My favorite projects are the ones where I develop or apply a beautiful algorithm on a large dataset, and then develop the infrastructure to support that original idea. Projects that have Akka and linear algebra in the same sentence really excite me. Recently I've become interested in using Lucene as a platform for machine learning. For backend, high throughput jobs I'm very comfortable with spark streaming and, if the use case is specific enough, Akka. However, I'm not tied to these frameworks as I'm always interested in learning something new.

positions.title: Senior Dev Lead
positions.description: Lead a team of six engineers to show relevant, sponsored content on search and product pages. We aggregate TB of click log data combined with NLP to find relevant e-commerce products for each individual based on browsing and search history.

positions.title: Infrastructure Engineer / Team Lead
positions.description: LiftIgniter is a Y-Combinator startup focused on providing machine learned content recommendations. What makes Liftigniter unique is that our models are updated in realtime to reflect the changing preferences in users. We train our models over billions of click stream activities per month.

positions.title: Big Data Research Engineer
positions.description: I develop infrastructure and algorithms to make sense of the millions of malicious files and billions of network packets we capture.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: Developed software and algorithms for the radiation oncology department of Stanford Hospitals. See patents and publications.

positions.title: Algorithm/Software Developer
positions.description: Developed and modified signal processing algorithms for low power microcontrollers.

publications.title: 4D CT lung ventilation images are affected by the 4D CT sorting method
An automated method for comparing motion artifacts in cine four-dimensional computed tomography images

patents.title: 4D Anatomically Based Image Selection Procedure for Medical Imaging
